notes.title: Update notes for Dec 17
notes.notes:
Thank you for all your feedback!

[list]
[*] Increased game internal speed two times (e.g., missions are not 30s but 15s now)
[*] Added possibility to skip to the end of the day, when no missions are on the map at the end of the day
[*] Fixed time not stopping when the player is in the city
[*] Fixed Cleopatra not removing half of the soldiers and daily income
[*] Fixed gold mine not generating resources and not gold
[*] Fixed typos and misleading texts
[/list]

notes.title: It is happening! Long Live Caesar will release on 16.12.2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38378272/ff618d81bc039c4e042d4dcb8f0b1e0fdb802a48.jpg[/img]

[i]This is not a dream... It’s finally happening![/i]

The game you’ve been eagerly awaiting for four years will be in your hands in less than two weeks.

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to all our supporters who never gave up hope during this journey. Your trust and dedication mean the world to us.

Thank you for standing by us.

With deepest appreciation,
The Long Live Caesar Team
